notes: Clicking a new position now reads as one move: the portal fades out where it is over 700ms, the window is moved while nothing is on screen, and it fades back in at the new spot over 700ms (CEO: "click -> fade out -> move -> fade in").

⚠️ Only the side that ORDERS the move can do this. A renderer finds out its window moved strictly after the fact, so anything it fades is already in the wrong place - three passes were spent shortening that wrongness before it was clear no…

The fade itself belongs to every portal, not to Mirage: it is in the shared entrance stylesheet and one call in the shared entrance module, so Charm and Omen inherit it the moment they ask for it. A snap that lands where the panel already…

The card frost is carried by that fade instead of running one of its own - it is placed and at full strength before the portal becomes visible again, so the glass arrives with the panel rather than filling in behind it. Traced frame by…
